series.name: LED indicator / blink semantics (not separate fault codes)
series.notes: Lamp↔family semantics + blink reading method. Exact blink-count↔code map not recovered — do not invent counts.

title.ur: Running lamp — E-family (aur H6) ki report

meaning.en: On models without full text display, the Running indicator blinks to report E-series codes (and H6 per source); blink count corresponds to the code suffix within the repeating ~3 s cycle.
meaning.ur: Jin units par poora text display nahi hota, wahan Running indicator blink karke E-series codes (source ke mutabiq H6 bhi) dikhata hai; ~3 second ki dohrayi cycle mein blink ki tadaad code ke suffix ka digit batati hai.

causes.en: Reported fault in E family / H6
causes.ur: E family ya H6 ka fault report ho raha hai

solutions.en: Count blinks across the repeating interval; match to model’s code list; or read code on remote/display if available
solutions.ur: Pehle repeating interval ke darmiyan blinks count karein, apne model ki code list se milayein; remote/display par code dikh raha ho to woh parhein

source.title: airconditioningmanuals Gree page + maqsoodandsons reading method

notes.en: Exact blink count↔code table not recovered from a verified free source. Per-code attribution: airconditioningmanuals.
notes.ur: Exact blink count-code table verified free source se nahi mila. Per-code attribution: airconditioningmanuals.

codes.blinkPattern: E codes (+H6); period ~3 s between repeats

title.ur: Standard blink count karne ka tareeqa

meaning.en: Pattern = ~3 seconds OFF, then N flashes = digit N of the code (codes repeat cyclically). Duplicate confirmation on remote or indoor panel when available.
meaning.ur: Pattern: pehle ~3 second band rahe, phir N bar flash hon — woh code ka N number digit hai (codes baar baar repeat hote hain). Jahan mumkin ho, remote ya indoor panel par code dobara confirm bhi ho sakta hai.

causes.ur: Unit mein digital text display nahi hai

solutions.en: Count carefully over a full cycle; cross-check with remote code display
solutions.ur: Poore cycle par gaur se count karein; remote ke code display se cross-check karein

notes.en: Some units report 9 or 11 pulses per cycle per airconditioningmanuals — model-dependent. Per-code attribution: maqsoodandsons + airconditioningmanuals.
notes.ur: Kuch units airconditioningmanuals ke mutabiq har cycle mein 9 ya 11 pulses dete hain, yeh model par depend karta hai. Per-code attribution: maqsoodandsons + airconditioningmanuals.
